en.headline: Architectural Services Department says former manager left on personal grounds
en.dek: The department rejected reports that a chief project manager overseeing Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical building lifts was asked to resign, saying she applied three months in advance and left in mid-August.
body: The Architectural Services Department said on Saturday that reports linking the departure of a former chief project manager to problems with lifts at Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical building did not match the facts.

The department said the officer had applied to resign on personal grounds under the established mechanism three months in advance and left the civil service in mid-August. Suitable arrangements had been made to cover the work.

The Development Bureau has already begun a review of how the lift-installation case was handled and of accountability, including whether the two departments and relevant officers fell short in acceptance and supervision. The review is expected to be completed in October and a full account given to the relevant Legislative Council panel.

The Architectural Services Department said it would fully cooperate with the review and would hold relevant companies and individuals to account according to the findings, whether or not they had already left their posts. It declined to comment further on individual allegations at this stage.

The department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department are continuing to supervise the contractor and subcontractor on remaining rectification works for the lifts, which are expected to be completed within the fourth quarter of this year.

zh.headline: 建築署：前總工程策劃經理以個人理由請辭 與瑪麗升降機報道不符
zh.dek: 建築署指有關瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程的前總工程策劃經理被要求辭職的報道與事實不符，該人員已按機制提前三個月申請並於8月中離職。
body: 建築署周六回應，指有報道指前總工程策劃經理因瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機安裝工程事宜被要求辭職，與事實不符。
署方表示，該名人員以個人理由提出請辭，已按機制提前三個月提出申請，並於8月中離開公務員隊伍。署方已作出合適人事安排應付當前工作。
發展局日前已公開表示已開展有關審視個案處理及追責的工作，包括審視兩個部門及有關人員在該升降機工程的驗收及監管工作有否不足之處，並探討同類工程項目的監督制度是否有優化空間，預計於10月完成審視後盡快向立法會事務委員會作出全面交代。
建築署表示會全力配合發展局的審視和調查，並會按日後的審視結果追責相關公司和人士，不論是否已離職。現階段不宜就個別指控和揣測作進一步回應。
署方正聯同機電工程署嚴格監督承建商及工程分判商全速完成餘下執修工程，預計今年第四季內完成。
